task_context.problem_statement:
He then went to see the oranges being harvested. He found out that they harvest 28 sacks of ripe oranges and 52 sacks of unripe oranges per day.
How many sacks of oranges will they have after 26 days of harvest?
( ( 28.0 + 52.0 ) * 26.0 )
